answer_1.quote: Our results highlight ... the challenge of question position identification in generating guiding questions.

answer_2.quote: We report the average number of generated questions # Q, Rouge (L) , Meteor (Banerjee and Lavie, 2005), and BertScore.

answer_3.quote: The evaluation consists of three dimensions: Coherence, Consistency, and Informativeness, and is based on GPT-4, which has shown a superior correlation with human annotations on summary evaluation.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a between-group human study... Participants are asked to read articles with (or without) questions... Participants evaluate the intrinsic quality of each question from three aspects: relevance, position, and importance.
answer_4.guideline: Participants evaluate the intrinsic quality of each question from three aspects: relevance, position, and importance.
